ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice rested on two facts. First, the relevant capability evals are effectively tied: Petrel and Avocet differ by under 2 points on Support Dialogue (81.1 vs 78.9) and on the other applicable categories, so quality isn't a deciding factor. Second, the query's tone is warm and collaborative — Petrel self-reports a strong preference (64) for that task family, while Avocet self-reports a dislike for open-ended generative work (35). With capability a wash, I broke the tie using the preference profiles, sending a friendly, somewhat open-ended design task to the model that prefers that style.
